assumptions: Authorization is issue 2350 (repo-maintenance route, non-orchestrator), delegated by Albert's Claude session; no migration lane and no db claim.
Marker #2330 named in the issue is closed, so its stale session id needs no correction; only the resolver output is changed.
A liveness probe is not possible from this repository (no session API), so the fix makes the JSON state the address is unverified.
goal: Make check-orchestrator-marker --resolve --json state that a declared target's reachability is unverified, so exit 0 is not read as a working route.
prohibited_actions: No database, migration, preview, production, claim or marker mutation.
No change to exit codes or the state field consumed by manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs.
No workflow, repository setting or branch protection change.
stop_conditions: Stop if the change would alter exit codes or the state field.
Stop if any marker or lanes-manager test fails.
